answer: Reputation decays with an exponential half-life, so a node must provide sustained, honest service to retain weight; a burst of activity cannot buy durable influence. In the EigenTrust trust trellis, a freshly spawned Sybil has near-zero eigenvector centrality, and reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot turn unsupported links into consensus power. A velvet disguise on a brief voyage does not replace the history needed to pass consensus.
